verification_scope: Twelve actual container-only Chromium platform/browser regressions. Six ordinary positive acceptance reports, five expected candidate rejection reports and one trusted platform API qualification. Old frozen comparison preserved separately; no actual Android/iOS WebView or human playtest claimed.

isolation.filesystem: read-only root and input; separate evidence mount

limits: Web Audio source scheduling used an ALSA null sink; audible quality not claimed.
Lifecycle events and explicitly named negative detached API events are synthetic, separate from real key/click/touch gameplay inputs.
Game and bridge share one realm: no proof against deliberately falsified mechanics.
Reviewed fixture API conformance is not a fresh live model quality measurement. Target WebView unknown.
